fees.note: Village of Daajing Giids campground page: drive-in sites C$20 a night, walk-in tent sites C$15, charged per site whatever the rig; water in summer only. Books online through Let's Camp.
Bloomfield City Council raised the camping fee to $20 a night on 6 March 2025; tent camping stays $10. First come, first served; self-register at the booth.
City of Rosiclare services page: $21 a night for the 12 water/electric sites, $18 a night for stays of 7 nights or more.
Starke County Parks campground rates: $50 a night, $55 on holidays (3-night minimum on holidays), $300 a week; tent sites $25, $30 with electric. Reservations and payments are non-refundable.
Town of Earl Park: $25 a night for a camper, $15 for a tent, $10 to use the dump station. Camping runs from Memorial Day weekend to 30 September.

Marathon County fee schedule, 2026 column (posted November 2025 as proposed): 24 electric sites $29 a night, 4 non-electric $24 (2025: $27 and $22; 2027: $30 and $25); $10 reservation fee, $8 dump station.

source: https://www.marathoncounty.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/15121/638987337442730000 (Proposed 2026 Facility and Program Fees and 2027 Facility/Shelter/Campground Fees; read 2026-10-11)

fees.note: Village of Blanchardville campground page: RV site $25 a night with electric and water, $150 a week; tents $5 a night. Reservation requests go to the village for approval; open April 1 - October 30.
An RV Life reviewer paid $40 a night in March 2024 for a full-hookup site by the creek. No operator rate page (kymulgagristmill.com is for sale); confirm by phone.
An RV Life reviewer paid $25 a night in October 2024. No operator rate page (McCreary County tourism lists the park without prices); confirm by phone.
A Campendium reviewer paid $55 a night in July 2025, cash only. No operator rate page (the park posts on Facebook only); confirm by phone.
